branches.en: The first sense is the general feeling of effort.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那种整体的费劲感。

branches.en: The second sense turns that fog into one named obstacle.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把那团雾凝成一处有名字的障碍。

branches.en: The third sense moves the obstacle into the wallet.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把障碍挪进了钱包。

branches.en: Effort and obstacle are the inside and outside of one thing.
branches.cn: 费劲与障碍，是同一件事的里面和外面。

branches.en: A shortage of money is simply the hardest obstacle.
branches.cn: 缺钱不过是那堵最难翻的墙。

intro.en: Difficulty shares its base with difficult and with the fac- words about making and ease.
intro.cn: difficulty 与 difficult 同基，也与 fac 一族表示「做」和「容易」的词同源。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin facere, to make or to do, seen in facilis, easy.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 facere（做），在 facilis（容易）里也能看到。

items.example: The difficulty lies in the last step.
items.exampleCN: 困难就在最后一步。

items.example: The choice was a difficult one.
items.exampleCN: 这个选择很难。

items.example: He spoke difficultly after the accident.
items.exampleCN: 事故之后他说话很吃力。

items.example: The plan met difficulties early.
items.exampleCN: 计划一开始就遇上困难。

items.example: That is a facile explanation.
items.exampleCN: 那是个过于省事的解释。

items.example: Good light facilitates reading.
items.exampleCN: 光线好，读书就省力。

items.meaning: ease, or a place for an activity
items.example: The hotel has a small sports facility.
items.exampleCN: 这家旅馆有个小运动场所。

items.meaning: a power of mind or body, or a teaching body
items.example: The faculty met on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 全体教员周一开了会。

definition_en: to break and move earth, or to search deeply for something
core_image: 铁锹插进湿土，翻起一铲发黑的泥，旁边堆起小小的土丘
scene: 院子里那棵老树旁，男人一铲一铲往下探。They dug a narrow hole beside the fence.
sceneCN: 这里 dug 指「挖」（第 1 个义项：把土翻开）；句意是他们在篱笆旁挖了一个窄洞。

senses.title: To turn the earth
senses.definition: to break the ground and lift the soil away
senses.definitionCN: 把地面破开，把土铲走
senses.example: They dug a narrow hole beside the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在篱笆旁挖了一个窄洞。
senses.why: The hand works downward and the ground gives way.
senses.whyCN: 手往下使劲，地就让开了。

senses.title: To search deep below
senses.definition: to look for something by going far below the surface
senses.definitionCN: 钻到表层以下很远去找东西
senses.example: The team dug for old coins all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 整个夏天，这支队伍都在挖找古币。
senses.why: What is wanted lies under a layer, and the layer must be removed.
senses.whyCN: 想要的东西在一层东西下面，那层必须被搬开。

senses.title: A small cutting remark
senses.definition: a short remark that quietly makes fun of someone
senses.definitionCN: 一句不动声色取笑别人的短话
senses.example: He took the dig about his old car quietly.
senses.exampleCN: 别人挖苦他那辆旧车，他没作声。
senses.why: A remark can go under the skin the way a spade goes under soil.
senses.whyCN: 一句话能钻进皮肉，像铲子钻进泥土。

intro.en: Dig appears in Middle English as diggen, probably from an Anglo-French verb for cutting a ditch.
intro.cn: dig 在中古英语里写作 diggen，可能出自表示「开沟」的英法混合语动词。

items.en: Digue meant a dike, a bank raised to hold water.
items.cn: digue 指堤坝，为挡水而筑起的土埂。

items.en: Diguer meant to cut a ditch or a channel.
items.cn: diguer 指开沟、挖渠。

items.en: Diggen took the plain sense of moving earth with a tool.
items.cn: diggen 承接了「用工具翻土」这层直白意思。

items.en: The verb widened to hunting for buried things.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到寻找埋在地下的东西。

items.en: Dig also became a noun for a teasing remark and for a site being explored.
items.cn: dig 还变成名词，指一句取笑的话或一处发掘地。

note.en: The look-alike group is close in spelling, while the meaning group covers digging, tunnelling and searching deep.
note.cn: 形近组拼写接近，近义组则覆盖挖掘、打洞与深入寻找。

entries.definition: a person or machine that digs
a long wall of earth built to hold water back
the past form of dig
to remove earth carefully from a site
entries.definitionCN: 在现场小心地挖走泥土

entries.definition: to make a hole or tunnel and live in it
entries.definitionCN: 打洞或钻隧道并住在里面

entries.definition: to search deeply into a subject or a container
entries.definitionCN: 深入探究某个题目或翻找容器

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a spade biting wet soil and end with a remark that bites a person.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从铁锹咬进湿土开始，最后落到一句咬人的话。

normal.en: Dig, dug, dug: the vowel drops as the spade goes down.
normal.cn: dig、dug、dug：铲子往下走，元音也跟着沉下去。

normal.en: Dig up brings to the surface; dig into goes further in.
normal.cn: dig up 是把东西翻上来，dig into 是继续往里走。

normal.en: Dig deep is advice for muscles and for courage.
normal.cn: dig deep 既是对肌肉说的，也是对勇气说的。

normal.en: An archaeologist digs slowly because the past breaks easily.
normal.cn: 考古的人挖得慢，因为过去一碰就碎。

normal.en: A dig in conversation leaves no hole, only a bruise.
normal.cn: 话里的 dig 不留洞，只留一块淤青。

abstract.en: Picture a spade cutting a clean line in dark soil.
abstract.cn: 想象铁锹在黑土上切出一道干净的线。

abstract.en: Picture a small hill of earth growing beside a hole.
abstract.cn: 想象洞旁边慢慢堆起一座小土丘。

abstract.en: Picture a hand brushing dust off something buried.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手拂去埋着的东西上的土。

examples.en: The dog dug under the gate again.
examples.cn: 那条狗又在门底下刨洞了。

examples.en: She dug into the old records for hours.
examples.cn: 她在旧档案里翻找了好几个小时。

examples.en: He made a quiet dig about her lateness.
examples.cn: 他轻声挖苦了一句她迟到的事。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dig 记成「地哥」：地哥拿着铲子，一寸寸往地里探。

root: 中古英语作 diggen，可能来自表示「开沟」的英法混合语 diguer，而 digue 指堤坝。本义是用工具翻土开沟，后来扩展到挖掘寻找埋藏之物，也用于比喻深入探究；作名词时，又指一句带刺的取笑话或一处发掘现场。

sensesIntro.en: From a spade lifting soil, to a search under the surface, to a remark that goes under the skin.
sensesIntro.cn: 从铁锹翻土，到地表之下的寻找，再到一句钻进皮肉的话。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spade biting into wet soil and lifting it aside.
core.cn: 核心意象：铁锹咬进湿土，再把它掀到一边。

chain: A WORD CUTS UNDER THE SKIN

branches.en: The first sense is the plain act of moving earth.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是翻土这个直白动作。

branches.en: The second sense adds a purpose and a depth.
branches.cn: 第二个义项添上了目的与深度。

branches.en: The third sense turns the tool into a remark.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把工具换成了一句话。

branches.en: Every excavation begins with one shovel of soil.
branches.cn: 每一次发掘都从一铲土开始。

branches.en: Both go below the surface, one for facts and one for feeling.
branches.cn: 两者都往表层以下走，一个找事实，一个碰感受。

intro.en: Dig forms a small family of tools, actions and holes, with almost no Latin help.
intro.cn: dig 长出一小族词，涉及工具、动作与洞穴，几乎不靠拉丁语。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic and French in origin; there is no Latin base behind this family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根出自日耳曼语与法语，这一族词背后没有拉丁词基。

items.example: They dig a well every spring.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年春天挖一口井。

items.example: The digger cleared the whole bank.
items.exampleCN: 挖掘机清空了整道土坡。

items.example: Digging here is slow and careful.
items.exampleCN: 在这里挖掘要慢而细。

items.example: They dug the trench by hand.
items.exampleCN: 他们用手挖了那条沟。

items.example: He digs the garden every autumn.
items.exampleCN: 他每年秋天翻园子。

items.meaning: a hole in the ground used as shelter
items.example: The soldiers waited in a dugout.
items.exampleCN: 士兵们在地洞里等着。

items.example: The soil here is barely diggable.
items.exampleCN: 这里的土几乎挖不动。

items.meaning: earth removed, or a place being worked
items.example: The old diggings are now a park.
items.exampleCN: 那片旧采掘场如今是个公园。

definition_en: to break down food in the body, to take in information, or a short summary of a longer text
core_image: 一大块面包泡在温水里，慢慢散成看不见的细末
scene: 他饭后靠在椅背上，等胃把那顿硬面包慢慢化开。It takes hours to digest such a heavy meal.
sceneCN: 这里 digest 指「消化」（第 1 个义项：把食物分解吸收）；句意是这么油腻的一顿要几个小时才能消化。

senses.title: To break down food
senses.definition: to change food in the body into something it can use
senses.definitionCN: 在体内把食物变成身体能用的东西
senses.example: Some people cannot digest milk easily.
senses.exampleCN: 有些人不容易消化牛奶。
senses.why: A large piece must become small before the body can take it.
senses.whyCN: 大块的东西必须先变碎，身体才拿得走。

senses.title: To take in ideas
senses.definition: to read or hear something and make it your own
senses.definitionCN: 读过或听过之后，把它变成自己的东西
senses.example: Give the class time to digest the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 给学生一点时间消化这条新规则。
senses.why: The mind chews in the same slow way the stomach does.
senses.whyCN: 脑子咀嚼的节奏，和胃一样慢。

senses.title: A short version of a text
senses.definition: a small collection of the main points of longer writing
senses.definitionCN: 把较长文字的主要意思收成一小份
senses.example: The magazine prints a monthly digest of new research.
senses.exampleCN: 这本杂志每月印一份新研究摘要。
senses.why: What has been digested comes out shorter and easier to carry.
senses.whyCN: 被消化过的东西，出来时更短也更好带。

intro.en: Digest comes from Latin digerere, to carry apart, from dis-, apart, and gerere, to carry.
intro.cn: digest 来自拉丁语 digerere（分开搬运），由 dis-（分开）与 gerere（搬、带）构成。

items.en: Gerere meant to carry or to manage a burden.
items.cn: gerere 指搬运，也指料理一份负担。

items.en: Digerere meant to separate things and set them in order.
items.cn: digerere 指把东西分开，再排好顺序。

items.en: Medical writers used it for the body softening food.
items.cn: 医学作者用它形容身体把食物化开。

items.en: English digest covered food, and soon also books.
items.cn: 英语 digest 先指食物，很快也用于书。

items.en: The noun came to mean a compact collection of articles.
items.cn: 名词义后来指把文章收成一小册。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the gest- ending, while the meaning group covers absorbing, summarising and blending in.
note.cn: 形近组共用 gest 结尾，近义组则覆盖吸收、概括与融会。

entries.definition: to move away from the main subject while speaking
relating to the process of digesting food
easy for the body to break down
to take in liquid, energy or knowledge
a short account of the main points
to take in and make part of oneself
entries.definitionCN: 吸收并化为自身的一部分

normalIntro.en: These hooks go from bread softening in the stomach to a thick magazine folded into a thin summary.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从胃里化开的面包，走到一本厚杂志被折成一页薄摘要。

normal.en: The verb says dye-JEST; the noun says DYE-jest.
normal.cn: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前，意思也随之分工。

normal.en: The stomach digests food and the mind digests a chapter.
normal.cn: 胃消化食物，脑子消化一章书。

normal.en: A digest is what is left after all the chewing.
normal.cn: digest 是嚼完之后剩下的那一小份。

normal.en: Easy to digest is praise for soup and for prose.
normal.cn: easy to digest 既能夸汤，也能夸文章。

normal.en: Indigestion is the body refusing a hurried meal.
normal.cn: 消化不良，是身体拒绝一顿太急的饭。

abstract.en: Picture a slice of bread slowly losing its shape in water.
abstract.cn: 想象一片面包在水里慢慢失去形状。

abstract.en: Picture a thick book pressed down to ten thin pages.
abstract.cn: 想象一本厚书被压成十张薄纸。

abstract.en: Picture a reader nodding slowly as a hard idea settles.
abstract.cn: 想象一个难懂的念头落定，读者慢慢点头。

examples.en: He read the report and digested its main points.
examples.cn: 他读完报告，吸收了其中的要点。

examples.en: This soup is easy to digest.
examples.cn: 这种汤很容易消化。

examples.en: The digest arrives every Friday morning.
examples.cn: 这份文摘每周五早上送到。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 digest 记成「袋子嚼死它」：袋子里的东西一层层嚼碎，就是消化。

root: 来自拉丁语 digerere，由 dis-（分开）与 gerere（搬、带）构成，本义是把东西分开搬走、排好次序。医学上用它指身体把食物化开，于是有了「消化」；把厚材料化短，则有了「摘要」；把知识化进脑子，就是「理解吸收」。

sensesIntro.en: From food broken into pieces, to ideas taken in slowly, to a long text folded into a few pages.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被拆碎的食物，到慢慢吃进去的想法，再到把长文折成几页。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a large solid piece slowly breaking into fine parts.
core.cn: 核心意象：一大块结实的东西，慢慢散成细末。

branches.en: The first sense is the work of the stomach.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是胃干的活。

branches.en: The second sense hands the same work to the mind.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把同样的活交给脑子。

branches.en: The third sense keeps only the reduced result.
branches.cn: 第三个义项只留下被压缩后的成果。

branches.en: Body and mind both need time before they can use what comes in.
branches.cn: 身体和脑子都需要时间，才能用上进来的东西。

branches.en: A summary is proof that someone has already digested the text.
branches.cn: 摘要就是有人已经把全文消化过的证据。

intro.en: Digest gathers the gest- family, words about carrying, ordering and breaking down.
intro.cn: digest 聚起 gest 一族词，围绕搬运、排序与分解。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin gerere, to carry, with dis- meaning apart.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 gerere（搬、带），前缀 dis- 表示分开。

items.meaning: to break down and take in
items.example: Children digest milk more easily.
items.exampleCN: 孩子消化牛奶更容易。

items.meaning: the process of breaking down food
items.example: Digestion starts in the mouth.
items.exampleCN: 消化从嘴里就开始了。

items.example: The digestive system is slow at night.
items.exampleCN: 夜里消化系统运转得慢。

items.example: Rice is highly digestible.
items.exampleCN: 米饭很容易消化。

items.example: He took a pill for indigestion.
items.exampleCN: 他吃了一片治消化不良的药。

items.example: The food was fully digested by noon.
items.exampleCN: 到中午食物已完全消化。

items.meaning: in the middle of breaking down
items.example: A snake rests while digesting.
items.exampleCN: 蛇在消化时会静卧不动。

items.example: Her stomach digests slowly.
items.exampleCN: 她的胃消化得慢。

definition_en: using numbers stored as electronic signals, especially in computers
core_image: 一块屏幕亮起，无数小方格排成图案，每个格子只有亮与不亮
scene: 老人把胶片相机收进抽屉，换了一台薄薄的机器。All the photos are now stored in digital form.
sceneCN: 这里 digital 指「数字的」（第 1 个义项：以数字信号记录）；句意是如今所有照片都以数字形式保存。

senses.title: Stored as numbers
senses.definition: recorded as a series of numbers that a machine can read
senses.definitionCN: 被记录成一串机器能读的数字
senses.example: The signal is converted into digital form.
senses.exampleCN: 信号被转换成数字形式。
senses.why: A smooth wave is cut into steps that a chip can count.
senses.whyCN: 平滑的波被切成格子，芯片才数得清。

senses.title: Built around such signals
senses.definition: describing devices and services that work with such signals
senses.definitionCN: 形容依靠这类信号运转的设备与服务
senses.example: The digital camera fits in a coat pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 这台数码相机能塞进外套口袋。
senses.why: The product is named after the kind of signal inside it.
senses.whyCN: 产品是照着它内部那种信号来命名的。

senses.title: Relating to a finger
senses.definition: relating to a finger or a toe in medical use
senses.definitionCN: 医学上指与手指或脚趾有关
senses.example: The surgeon repaired a digital nerve.
senses.exampleCN: 外科医生修复了一根手指神经。
senses.why: The oldest sense comes from counting on the fingers.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的那层意思，来自扳着手指计数。

intro.en: Digital comes from Latin digitus, a finger, because people once counted on their fingers.
intro.cn: digital 来自拉丁语 digitus（手指），因为人最早是扳着手指计数的。

items.en: Digitus meant a finger or a toe.
items.cn: digitus 指手指或脚趾。

items.en: The same word named a numeral, since fingers were the first counters.
items.cn: 同一个词也指数目，因为手指是最早的算具。

items.en: English digit meant a number below ten.
items.cn: 英语 digit 指十以下的数字。

items.en: Digital described anything done with a finger.
items.cn: digital 形容任何用手指完成的事。

items.en: Electronics gave the word its current sense of number-coded signals.
items.cn: 电子技术让它有了今天「数字编码信号」的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the digit- stem, while the meaning group covers numbers, electronics and two-state coding.
note.cn: 形近组共用 digit 词干，近义组则覆盖数值、电子与两态编码。

entries.definition: one of the numbers from zero to nine
the quality of deserving respect
to turn information into numbers
expressed by numbers
working with tiny electric circuits
using only two states, such as on and off
entries.definitionCN: 只用通与断这两种状态的

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with fingers used for counting and end with a screen of on and off cells.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从数数的手指开始，最后落到一块只有亮与不亮的屏幕。

normal.en: Digit is a finger first and a number second.
normal.cn: digit 先是手指，后才是数字。

normal.en: Ten fingers gave us ten digits, and digits gave us digital.
normal.cn: 十根手指给出十个数字，数字又给出 digital。

normal.en: Digital sound is a wave cut into tiny stairs.
normal.cn: 数字声音是被切成小台阶的波。

normal.en: A digital photo is a grid of numbers pretending to be light.
normal.cn: 数码照片是一格数字假装成光。

normal.en: Before screens, digital meant done with a finger.
normal.cn: 在有屏幕之前，digital 只表示用手指做的事。

abstract.en: Picture a hand holding up three fingers to count.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手举起三根手指在数数。

abstract.en: Picture a waveform chopped into equal steps.
abstract.cn: 想象一条波形被切成等高的台阶。

abstract.en: Picture a grid of cells where each is either lit or dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一片方格，每一格要么亮，要么暗。

examples.en: Most music is now sold in digital form.
examples.cn: 如今大多数音乐以数字形式出售。

examples.en: The digital clock lost a minute every month.
examples.cn: 这台数字钟每个月慢一分钟。

examples.en: Older workers often fear the digital age.
examples.cn: 年长的工人常常害怕数字时代。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 digital 记成「地记头」：地上一格一格记下来，数字排好，就是数码。

root: 来自拉丁语 digitus（手指）。人最早扳手指计数，所以同一个词也指数目，英语 digit 便指零到九的数字。二十世纪电子技术用「只有通与断两种状态」的方式记录信息，digital 因此获得今天「数字的、数码的」这层含义，而医学上仍保留「手指的」原义。

sensesIntro.en: From counting on fingers, to a signal counted by a chip, to the devices built on that signal, and back to the finger itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 从扳手指计数，到芯片数得出的信号，到靠这种信号运转的设备，最后回到手指本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a grid of cells, each either lit or dark, forming a picture.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片方格，每格或亮或暗，凑成一幅图。

chain: A CHIP READS ON AND OFF

branches.en: The first sense is the coded signal itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是那串被编码的信号。

branches.en: The second sense names the machines built on it.
branches.cn: 第二个义项指靠它运转的机器。

branches.en: The third sense returns to the body part.
branches.cn: 第三个义项回到身体部位。

branches.en: The signal and the device share one adjective.
branches.cn: 信号与设备共用同一个形容词。

branches.en: The newest sense and the oldest both trace back to fingers.
branches.cn: 最新的意思与最老的意思，都能追回到手指。

intro.en: Digital belongs to the digit- family, running from fingers to numbers to machine code.
intro.cn: digital 属于 digit 一族，从手指一路走到数字，再到机器编码。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin digitus, a finger, which also gave the word for a numeral.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 digitus（手指），它同时给出了「数字」这个词。

items.example: The archive is fully digital.
items.exampleCN: 这批档案已全部数字化。

items.example: Write the answer as a single digit.
items.exampleCN: 把答案写成一个数字。

items.example: The form can be signed digitally.
items.exampleCN: 这张表可以在线签名。

items.example: They digitize old tapes each winter.
items.exampleCN: 他们每年冬天把旧磁带数字化。

items.meaning: the act of converting to numbers
items.example: Digitization saved the fragile maps.
items.exampleCN: 数字化抢救了那些易碎的地图。

items.example: Digitalization changed the whole office.
items.exampleCN: 数字化改变了整个办公室。

items.meaning: a plant named for its finger-shaped flowers
items.example: Digitalis is used in small doses.
items.exampleCN: 毛地黄只以小剂量入药。

items.example: The code has six digits.
items.exampleCN: 这个密码有六位数字。

definition_zh: 昏暗的；模糊的；迟钝的；使变暗
definition_en: not bright, not clearly seen, or not quick to understand
core_image: 走廊尽头那盏灯泡蒙着灰，光只照到半面墙
scene: 走廊尽头那盏灯泡蒙着灰，人影走近才看得清。The lamp grew dim as the evening went on.
sceneCN: 这里 dim 指「昏暗的」（第 1 个义项：光线不明亮）；句意是天色渐晚，那盏灯越来越暗。

senses.title: Giving little light
senses.definition: not bright, so that shapes are hard to see
senses.definitionCN: 光不亮，连轮廓都很难看清
senses.example: They ate supper by a dim lamp.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在一盏昏暗的灯下吃晚饭。
senses.why: The light is there, but it reaches only halfway across the room.
senses.whyCN: 光还在，只是只照到屋子的一半。

senses.title: Faint in the memory
senses.definition: remembered or seen without clear edges
senses.definitionCN: 记得或看见，却带着毛边
senses.example: I have only a dim memory of that winter.
senses.exampleCN: 那个冬天我只剩一点模糊的记忆。
senses.why: The picture is still there, but the light on it has faded.
senses.whyCN: 画面还在，照在上面的光却淡了。

senses.title: Slow to understand
senses.definition: not quick at seeing or understanding something
senses.definitionCN: 看事或懂事不够快
senses.example: He was dim about the joke until everyone laughed.
senses.exampleCN: 直到大家都笑了，他才明白那个玩笑。
senses.why: The lamp inside the head burns low as well.
senses.whyCN: 脑袋里的那盏灯也烧得很暗。

intro.en: Dim comes from Old English dimm, a Germanic word for darkness that has changed very little.
intro.cn: dim 来自古英语 dimm，是一个表示黑暗的日耳曼词，形状几乎没变。

items.en: A root dim- described mist and weak light.
items.cn: 词根 dim- 形容雾气与微弱的光。

items.en: Dimm meant dark or gloomy.
items.cn: dimm 指暗、阴沉的。

items.en: The word also described eyesight that had weakened.
items.cn: 这个词也开始形容衰退的视力。

items.en: The verb sense of making a light weaker appeared.
items.cn: 「把灯调暗」的动词用法出现。

items.en: Dim now covers light, memory and slow understanding.
items.cn: 如今 dim 兼指光线、记忆与迟钝的理解。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one sound, while the meaning group offers various kinds of weak light.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个音，近义组则给出几种不同的弱光。

entries.definition: a small coin worth ten cents
a loud and unpleasant noise
a switch that lowers the light
weak and barely possible to see or hear
entries.definitionCN: 微弱得几乎看不见或听不见的

entries.definition: dark and unclear, as dirty water is
entries.definitionCN: 像脏水那样暗而浑浊的

entries.definition: not bright, sharp or interesting
entries.definitionCN: 不明亮、不锋利也不有趣的

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with one dusty bulb and end with a mind that needs the joke explained.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一只蒙灰的灯泡开始，最后落到一颗要人解释笑话的脑袋。

normal.en: Dim, dimmer, dimmest: the word itself fades as it grows.
normal.cn: dim、dimmer、dimmest：这个词自己越写越淡。

normal.en: Dim the lights and the room loses its edges.
normal.cn: 把灯调暗，屋子就丢了边。

normal.en: A dim memory is a photo left too long in the sun.
normal.cn: 模糊的记忆，是晒了太久的照片。

normal.en: Dim does not mean stupid; it means slow to catch the light.
normal.cn: dim 不等于蠢，只是接光慢一点。

normal.en: Twilight is the sky dimming without a switch.
normal.cn: 黄昏是天自己在变暗，不用开关。

abstract.en: Picture a bulb with dust on the glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一只玻璃上积了灰的灯泡。

abstract.en: Picture a face turning away into shadow.
abstract.cn: 想象一张脸转进阴影里。

abstract.en: Picture a path that fades before the gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一条小路在门前就淡掉了。

examples.en: The stage was dim before the music began.
examples.cn: 音乐响起前，舞台一片昏暗。

examples.en: His dim memory of the town slowly returned.
examples.cn: 他对那座小镇的模糊记忆慢慢回来了。

examples.en: Please dim the lights a little.
examples.cn: 请把灯调暗一点。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dim 记成「低暗」：灯一低，光就暗，看什么都蒙着一层。

root: 来自古英语 dimm，出自日耳曼语表示雾气与弱光的词根，千百年来形状几乎未变。本义是「暗、阴沉」，后来用于形容视力与记忆的模糊，又引申为理解迟钝；作动词时表示把光调弱。

sensesIntro.en: From a weak lamp, to a memory without edges, to a mind that catches the point late.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一盏弱灯，到一段没有边界的记忆，再到一颗迟迟才接住意思的脑袋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dusty bulb whose light stops halfway across the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只蒙灰的灯泡，光到半面墙就停住。

chain: THE EYE STRAINS FOR THE OUTLINE

branches.en: The first sense is about the light in a room.
branches.cn: 第一个义项说的是屋里的光。

branches.en: The second sense moves the weak light into memory.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把弱光挪进记忆里。

branches.en: The third sense puts the weak light inside a head.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把弱光放进一颗脑袋。

branches.en: Both are pictures missing their edges.
branches.cn: 两者都是丢了边的画面。

branches.en: A fading picture and a slow mind share one word.
branches.cn: 褪色的画面与迟缓的脑子共用一个词。

intro.en: Dim grows a small family of adverbs, nouns and switched lights.
intro.cn: dim 长出一小族词，包括副词、名词与可调的灯。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base here; the word is native Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词是本土的日耳曼词。

items.example: The corridor stayed dim all day.
items.exampleCN: 走廊一整天都昏暗。

items.example: Two figures stood dimly at the door.
items.exampleCN: 门口隐隐站着两个人影。

items.example: The dimness hid the cracks.
items.exampleCN: 昏暗把裂缝藏了起来。

items.example: Turn the dimmer down a little.
items.exampleCN: 把调光器再调低一点。

items.example: That corner is the dimmest in the house.
items.exampleCN: 那个角落是屋里最暗的。

items.example: The windows were dimmed by dust.
items.exampleCN: 灰尘把窗户弄得发暗。

items.example: The dimming sky warned of rain.
items.exampleCN: 天色转暗，预示着要下雨。

items.example: He called himself a dimwit for forgetting.
items.exampleCN: 他忘了这事，骂自己笨。

definition_en: a measurement of length, width or height, or one part of a situation
core_image: 一只木箱被卷尺量过三次，长、宽、高各贴一张小纸条
scene: 木匠把卷尺拉开，沿箱子的三条边各量一次。The room's dimensions are printed on the plan.
sceneCN: 这里 dimensions 指「尺寸」（第 1 个义项：长宽高的大小）；句意是这个房间的尺寸印在图纸上。

senses.title: A measured size
senses.definition: a length, width or height that can be measured
senses.definitionCN: 可以量出来的长、宽或高
senses.example: Check the dimensions before you buy the table.
senses.exampleCN: 买桌子之前先看尺寸。
senses.why: A thing in space always asks to be measured in more than one way.
senses.whyCN: 空间里的东西，总要被不止一种方式量过。

senses.title: One direction in space
senses.definition: one of the directions in which space or a model extends
senses.definitionCN: 空间或模型伸展的某一个方向
senses.example: A line has only one dimension.
senses.exampleCN: 一条线只有一个维度。
senses.why: Counting the directions turns a shape into a number.
senses.whyCN: 把方向数出来，形状就变成了一个数。

senses.title: One side of a matter
senses.definition: one part of a situation that must be considered
senses.definitionCN: 一件事中必须被考虑到的一面
senses.example: The story has a moral dimension as well.
senses.exampleCN: 这个故事还有道德层面。
senses.why: Problems have depth too, and each depth is called a dimension.
senses.whyCN: 问题也有厚度，每一层厚度都叫一个维度。

intro.en: Dimension comes from Latin dimensio, a measuring out, from metiri, to measure.
intro.cn: dimension 来自拉丁语 dimensio（量出），词根是 metiri（测量）。

items.en: Metiri meant to measure land or length.
items.cn: metiri 指丈量土地或长度。

items.en: Dimetiri meant to measure out in full.
items.cn: dimetiri 指完整地量出。

items.en: Dimensio named the result of that measuring.
items.cn: dimensio 指量过之后得到的结果。

items.en: English dimension meant size as measured.
items.cn: 英语 dimension 指量出来的大小。

items.en: Science added the sense of an axis, and common use added the sense of an aspect.
items.cn: 科学添上「坐标轴」的意思，日常用法又添上「方面」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the men- sound, while the meaning group covers size, aspect and extent.
note.cn: 形近组共用 men 这一段音，近义组则覆盖大小、方面与范围。

entries.definition: to become or make smaller
to speak or write about briefly
having a certain number of dimensions
how large or small something is
one part or feature of a situation
entries.definitionCN: 情况的一个部分或特征

entries.definition: the area or degree something reaches
entries.definitionCN: 某物达到的范围或程度

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from three tape marks on a box to a story with a moral side.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从箱子上三道卷尺痕，走到一个有道德层面的故事。

normal.en: Measure, measure, measure: dimension is the count of directions.
normal.cn: 量一次，再量一次：dimension 就是方向的个数。

normal.en: A box needs three numbers; a story needs several sides.
normal.cn: 箱子要三个数，故事要好几面。

normal.en: Add a dimension means one more direction to walk in.
normal.cn: add a dimension 就是多出一个可走的方向。

normal.en: The same word measures a room and a moral question.
normal.cn: 同一个词既量房间，也量道德问题。

normal.en: Metiri is measure, and metre hides inside it.
normal.cn: metiri 是测量，metre 就藏在里面。

abstract.en: Picture a tape measure bent along the edge of a box.
abstract.cn: 想象卷尺贴着箱子边缘拐弯。

abstract.en: Picture three chalk marks at right angles.
abstract.cn: 想象三道互相垂直的粉笔线。

abstract.en: Picture a flat drawing that suddenly gains depth.
abstract.cn: 想象一张平面图忽然有了厚度。

examples.en: The sofa fits the dimensions of the room.
examples.cn: 这张沙发与房间的尺寸相合。

examples.en: Time is often called the fourth dimension.
examples.cn: 时间常被称作第四维。

examples.en: Her letter added a personal dimension to the case.
examples.cn: 她的来信为这个案子添了个人层面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dimension 记成「地门神」：门口的地要量一量，量出长宽高，就是尺寸。

root: 来自拉丁语 dimensio，词根 metiri 意为测量，前缀 di- 表示分开、逐项。本义是逐项量出的结果，即长宽高等尺寸；数学与物理把它抽象为「维度」，日常语言又把它引申为事情的「方面」与「规模」。

sensesIntro.en: From a tape laid along a box, to an axis in space, to a side of a question that must be weighed.
sensesIntro.cn: 从贴着箱子的卷尺，到空间中的一根轴，再到一个问题必须被衡量的那一面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three tape marks at right angles on one wooden box.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只木箱上三道互相垂直的卷尺痕。

branches.en: The first sense is the measured size of a thing.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是东西被量出来的大小。

branches.en: The second sense is a direction in space.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是空间里的一个方向。

branches.en: The third sense is a side of a situation.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是事情的一个面。

branches.en: Measuring a box and naming an axis use the same idea.
branches.cn: 量一只箱子与命名一根轴，用的是同一个想法。

branches.en: Depth in space becomes depth in meaning.
branches.cn: 空间里的深度，变成了意思上的深度。

intro.en: Dimension joins a family of measuring words built on the Latin root metiri.
intro.cn: dimension 加入一族表示测量的词，词根是拉丁语 metiri。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin metiri, to measure, seen also in metre and measure.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 metiri（测量），metre 与 measure 里也能看到它。

items.example: The dimension of the box surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 这只箱子的尺寸让我们意外。

items.example: Write the dimensions on the label.
items.exampleCN: 把尺寸写在标签上。

items.example: The model is three dimensional.
items.exampleCN: 这个模型是三维的。

items.example: The two shapes are dimensionally equal.
items.exampleCN: 这两个形状在尺寸上相等。

items.example: Poverty is a multidimensional problem.
items.exampleCN: 贫困是个多层面的问题。

items.meaning: to find the size of something
items.example: Measure the wall before buying paint.
items.exampleCN: 买漆之前先量墙。

items.example: Each measurement must be exact.
items.exampleCN: 每项测量都必须精确。

items.example: The room is four metres wide.
items.exampleCN: 这个房间宽四米。

definition_en: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening
core_image: 长桌上摆着冒热气的汤锅，几把椅子还空着等主人入座
scene: 厨房里汤锅咕嘟作响，孩子们被叫去洗手。Dinner was ready long before the guests arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 dinner 指「正餐」（第 1 个义项：一天的主餐）；句意是客人到之前很久，晚饭就做好了。

senses.title: The main meal
senses.definition: the largest and most formal meal of the day
senses.definitionCN: 一天中最丰盛、最正式的一餐
senses.example: We had dinner together every Sunday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们每个周日一起吃正餐。
senses.why: The day has one meal that gathers people instead of just feeding them.
senses.whyCN: 一天里总有一顿饭，是把人聚起来而不只是填饱。

senses.title: A formal evening meal
senses.definition: an evening meal held for guests on a special occasion
senses.definitionCN: 为客人举办、带有场合意味的晚宴
senses.example: The hotel held a dinner for two hundred guests.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店为两百位客人办了晚宴。
senses.why: Food becomes the excuse for seating people in a certain order.
senses.whyCN: 饭菜成了借口，真正要做的是把人按次序排好。

senses.title: A meal sold ready to heat
senses.definition: a complete meal prepared and packed for quick heating
senses.definitionCN: 预先做好、包装起来、加热即食的一餐
senses.example: He ate a frozen dinner alone in front of the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 他一个人对着屏幕吃了份冷冻速食餐。
senses.why: The word keeps the ritual while giving up the table.
senses.whyCN: 这个词留下了仪式，却丢掉了那张桌子。

intro.en: Dinner comes from Old French disner, which first meant the morning meal that broke a night of fasting.
intro.cn: dinner 来自古法语 disner，最初指结束一夜禁食的那顿早饭。

items.en: Jejunus meant fasting, and dis- undid it.
items.cn: jejunus 指禁食，前缀 dis- 把它解除。

items.en: Disjejunare meant to break the fast.
items.cn: disjejunare 指开斋、结束禁食。

items.en: Disner named the meal that ended the night.
items.cn: disner 指结束一夜的那顿饭。

items.en: The meal moved later in the day as work hours changed.
items.cn: 随着作息变化，这顿饭在一天里越挪越晚。

items.en: Dinner settled as the main evening meal in most homes.
items.cn: 在多数家庭里，dinner 固定为晚上的主餐。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by a single letter, while the meaning group names meals of different weight.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母，近义组则区分分量不同的几顿饭。

entries.definition: a person eating, or a small cheap restaurant
entries.definitionCN: 用餐的人，或便宜的小餐馆

entries.definition: to eat a formal meal
a loud confusing noise
a light evening meal
a large formal meal for many guests
entries.definitionCN: 为众多客人办的正式大宴

entries.definition: food eaten at one time of the day
entries.definitionCN: 一天中某一时段吃的一餐

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a fast broken at dawn and end with a frozen tray eaten in front of a screen.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从天亮时结束禁食开始，最后落到对着屏幕吃掉的一只冷冻餐盒。

normal.en: Dinner once meant breakfast: the meal that broke the fast.
normal.cn: dinner 原本指早饭：那顿结束禁食的饭。

normal.en: Dine, diner, dinner: the verb, the person, the meal.
normal.cn: dine 是动词，diner 是人，dinner 是那顿饭。

normal.en: Dinner is a time as much as a dish.
normal.cn: dinner 既是菜，也是一个时刻。

normal.en: A dinner party is a meal with assigned seats.
normal.cn: 晚宴就是一餐配好了座次的饭。

normal.en: The word stayed warm even when the table disappeared.
normal.cn: 桌子没了，这个词还是暖的。

abstract.en: Picture a pot still steaming on a long table.
abstract.cn: 想象长桌上有一口还在冒热气的锅。

abstract.en: Picture empty chairs waiting for people to sit down.
abstract.cn: 想象几把空椅子等人坐下。

abstract.en: Picture one tray eaten under the light of a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象一只餐盘在屏幕的光下被吃掉。

examples.en: Dinner is at seven, so do not be late.
examples.cn: 晚饭七点开始，别迟到。

examples.en: She invited the whole team to dinner.
examples.cn: 她请整个团队吃晚饭。

examples.en: He cooked dinner while the rain beat on the window.
examples.cn: 雨打窗户时，他在做晚饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dinner 记成「定呢」：一家人定在桌边，饭才算正餐。

root: 来自古法语 disner，可追到拉丁语 disjejunare，由 dis-（解除）与 jejunus（禁食）构成，本义是「开斋」，即一天的第一顿饭。随着作息改变，这顿主餐逐渐挪到傍晚，于是 dinner 在多数地区固定为晚餐或正餐，并引申出宴会与速食餐的意思。

sensesIntro.en: From the meal that broke a fast, to a table set for guests, to a tray heated alone.
sensesIntro.cn: 从结束禁食的一顿，到为客人摆好的桌，再到一个人加热的餐盘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steaming pot on a table with chairs waiting to be filled.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上的热锅，与等着被坐满的椅子。

branches.en: The first sense is the main meal itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是那顿主餐。

branches.en: The second sense adds guests and ceremony.
branches.cn: 第二个义项添上了客人，也添上了仪式。

branches.en: The third sense keeps the meal but loses the table.
branches.cn: 第三个义项留下了饭，丢掉了桌子。

branches.en: Any banquet begins as an ordinary dinner with more chairs.
branches.cn: 任何宴会，起初都只是一顿多摆了几把椅子的晚饭。

branches.en: The same word covers a family table and a plastic tray.
branches.cn: 同一个词，既指家里的饭桌，也指塑料餐盘。

intro.en: Dinner gathers a small family about eating, eaters and the things on the table.
intro.cn: dinner 聚起一小族词，围绕吃、吃的人与桌上的器物。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin jejunus, fasting, undone by dis- to mean breaking the fast.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 jejunus（禁食），前缀 dis- 表示解除，合起来就是开斋。

items.example: Dinner is served at six.
items.exampleCN: 正餐六点开。

items.example: They dined by candlelight.
items.exampleCN: 他们在烛光下用餐。

items.meaning: one who eats, or a small restaurant
items.example: The diner was full by eight.
items.exampleCN: 八点时小餐馆已坐满。

items.meaning: the act of eating a meal
items.example: The dining room faces the garden.
items.exampleCN: 餐厅朝着花园。

items.example: She cooked dinners for the whole week.
items.exampleCN: 她把一周的晚饭都做好了。

items.meaning: plates and dishes for a meal
items.example: The dinnerware was stacked by the sink.
items.exampleCN: 餐具堆在水槽边。

items.meaning: the hour of the main meal
items.example: Dinnertime here is unusually late.
items.exampleCN: 这里的晚饭时间特别晚。

items.example: He went to bed dinnerless.
items.exampleCN: 他没吃晚饭就睡了。

definition_en: to put something briefly into liquid, or to go down and then up again
core_image: 一片面包被捏着边角，往热汤里按下去又提起来
scene: 他把面包掰开，捏着一角很快按进汤里。She dipped her hand in the cold stream.
sceneCN: 这里 dipped 指「浸入」（第 1 个义项：短时间放进液体里）；句意是她把手浸进冰凉的小溪。

senses.title: To put in liquid briefly
senses.definition: to lower something into liquid for a short moment
senses.definitionCN: 把东西放进液体里很短一会儿
senses.example: She dipped her hand in the cold stream.
senses.exampleCN: 她把手浸进冰凉的小溪。
senses.why: The hand goes down and comes back before the water can hold it.
senses.whyCN: 手沉下去又提起来，水还没来得及留住它。

senses.title: To fall and rise again
senses.definition: to go down for a while, as a number or a path does
senses.definitionCN: 像数字或道路那样暂时往下走
senses.example: Sales dipped below last year's level.
senses.exampleCN: 销量降到了去年的水平以下。
senses.why: The line on the chart bends down, then finds its way back.
senses.whyCN: 图上的线往下一沉，随后又找回自己。

senses.title: A hollow in the ground
senses.definition: a place where the surface goes down and then up
senses.definitionCN: 表面先往下再往上的一处地方
senses.example: A small dip in the road holds water after rain.
senses.exampleCN: 路上一个小坑雨后积着水。
senses.why: The motion of dipping becomes a shape in the land.
senses.whyCN: 「往下一沉」的动作，变成了地面上的一个形状。

intro.en: Dip comes from Old English dyppan, a Germanic verb for putting something into water.
intro.cn: dip 来自古英语 dyppan，是日耳曼语中表示「把东西放进水里」的动词。

items.en: A root dup- linked dipping with depth.
items.cn: 词根 dup- 把「浸」与「深」连在一起。

items.en: Dyppan meant to baptise or to plunge something in.
items.cn: dyppan 指施洗，或把东西按进水里。

items.en: Dippen widened to any short plunge into liquid.
items.cn: dippen 扩展到任何短时间的入水。

items.en: The noun named a hollow and a short swim.
items.cn: 名词义开始指凹坑与短暂的游泳。

items.en: Dipping also describes numbers falling for a while.
items.cn: dip 还用来形容数字暂时下滑。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the d- and short vowel, while the meaning group covers plunging, soaking and sinking.
note.cn: 形近组共用短元音与 d 开头，近义组则覆盖猛插、浸泡与下沉。

entries.definition: reaching far down from the top
entries.definitionCN: 从顶部往下延伸很远的

entries.definition: a long-handled cup for scooping liquid
a continuing loud noise
to push suddenly and deeply into something
to cover completely with liquid
to go down slowly below a surface

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with bread pressed into soup and end with a shallow hollow holding rain.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从按进汤里的面包开始，最后落到一个积着雨水的小坑。

normal.en: Dip and deep share a root: what you dip goes toward depth.
normal.cn: dip 与 deep 同根：浸下去，就是朝深处走。

normal.en: Dip in is quick; soak is long.
normal.cn: dip in 是快的一下，soak 是长时间泡。

normal.en: Take a dip means the whole body gets the treatment.
normal.cn: take a dip 是说整个人都进去泡一泡。

normal.en: A dip in sales is a hollow on a chart.
normal.cn: 销量的 dip，是图表上的一个凹口。

normal.en: Dip into a book, not through it.
normal.cn: dip into 一本书，是翻几页，不是读完。

abstract.en: Picture bread going under soup for one second.
abstract.cn: 想象面包在汤里沉了一秒。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon lifting dark liquid from a jar.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子从罐里舀起深色的液体。

abstract.en: Picture a shallow hollow shining after rain.
abstract.cn: 想象雨后的浅坑里亮着一小片水。

examples.en: He dipped a brush into the paint.
examples.cn: 他把刷子蘸进颜料里。

examples.en: Temperatures dipped below zero last night.
examples.cn: 昨夜气温降到了零度以下。

examples.en: There is a dip in the path just before the gate.
examples.cn: 门前的小路上有一处凹陷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dip 记成「低扑」：低下去一扑，蘸一下又起来。

root: 来自古英语 dyppan，出自日耳曼语词根 dup-，与 deep 同源，本义是把东西按进水里。后来泛指任何短促的浸蘸，又用来形容数字或道路先降后升，作名词则指地面的凹陷或短暂泡水。

sensesIntro.en: From a quick plunge of bread into soup, to a falling line, to the hollow that line leaves in the ground.
sensesIntro.cn: 从面包在汤里的一沉，到一条下落的线，再到那条线在地面上留下的凹坑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one corner of bread pressed under soup and lifted out.
core.cn: 核心意象：面包的一角按进汤里，又被提起来。

chain: A LINE ON A CHART BENDS DOWN

branches.en: The first sense is the short plunge into liquid.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是往液体里的那一沉。

branches.en: The second sense moves the plunge onto numbers.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这一沉挪到数字上。

branches.en: The third sense freezes the motion into ground.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这个动作冻成了地面。

branches.en: Both describe a short fall and a return.
branches.cn: 两者都描述短暂的下落与回返。

branches.en: A dip in a figure and a dip in a road look the same on paper.
branches.cn: 数字的下滑与路面的凹陷，画在纸上一个样。

intro.en: Dip forms a small family of scoops, tools and underwater birds.
intro.cn: dip 长出一小族词，涉及勺具、工具与潜水的水鸟。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word is native Germanic and related to deep.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词是本土日耳曼语，与 deep 同源。

items.example: Dip the cloth in warm water.
items.exampleCN: 把布浸到温水里。

items.example: She dipped the spoon twice.
items.exampleCN: 她把勺子蘸了两次。

items.example: Dipping the brush wastes paint.
items.exampleCN: 反复蘸刷子会浪费颜料。

items.example: The road dips near the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 路在桥附近凹下去。

items.example: He filled the dipper at the well.
items.exampleCN: 他在井边把长柄勺舀满。

items.meaning: a rod for checking oil level
items.example: Pull the dipstick and wipe it clean.
items.exampleCN: 拔出量油尺，擦干净。

items.example: The antenna is a simple dipole.
items.exampleCN: 这根天线是简单的偶极。

items.example: The old term dipsomania is rarely used now.
items.exampleCN: 嗜酒狂这个旧说法如今少见了。

definition_zh: 外交的；有外交手腕的；圆滑得体的
definition_en: relating to relations between countries, or skilled at handling people without giving offence
core_image: 两位代表分坐长桌两端，笑着握手，桌上各摆一面小旗
scene: 会谈结束后，双方代表在门口交换了几句客气话。Her diplomatic reply avoided a quarrel.
sceneCN: 这里 diplomatic 指「圆滑得体的」（第 2 个义项：不伤人地处理关系）；句意是她得体的回答避免了一场争吵。

pos.zh: 外交的；有外交手腕的；圆滑得体的

senses.title: Between countries
senses.definition: relating to the official relations of one country with another
senses.definitionCN: 与国与国之间的正式关系有关
senses.example: The two countries restored diplomatic relations.
senses.exampleCN: 两国恢复了外交关系。
senses.why: A border is a hard line, so words must do the work of bridges.
senses.whyCN: 边界是硬的线，只能让话语去当桥。

senses.title: Careful with people
senses.definition: saying a hard thing in a way that does not wound
senses.definitionCN: 把难听的话说得不伤人
senses.example: She gave a diplomatic answer and changed the subject.
senses.exampleCN: 她回答得很得体，随后换了话题。
senses.why: The same skill that keeps nations talking keeps a dinner pleasant.
senses.whyCN: 让两国继续说话的本事，也能让一顿饭不翻脸。

intro.en: Diplomatic comes from Latin diploma, a folded official letter, and Greek diploma, something folded in two.
intro.cn: diplomatic 来自拉丁语 diploma（对折的公文），更早可追到希腊语 diploma（折成两半的东西）。

items.en: Diploma meant a paper folded in two.
items.cn: diploma 指对折起来的纸。

items.en: Such folded papers carried letters of recommendation.
items.cn: 这种对折的纸常用来携带推荐文书。

items.en: Diploma named an official document of the state.
items.cn: diploma 指国家颁发的正式文书。

items.en: Diplomatique described the study of old official papers.
items.cn: diplomatique 指对古代公文的研究。

items.en: The word shifted from papers to the people who carry them.
items.cn: 这个词从文书转指拿着文书奔走的人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the diplo- stem, while the meaning group names tactful and courteous behaviour.
note.cn: 形近组共用 diplo 词干，近义组则指圆融与有礼的举止。

entries.definition: an official who represents a country abroad
the work of managing relations between countries
entries.definitionCN: 处理国与国关系的工作

entries.definition: a certificate given on finishing a course
entries.definitionCN: 完成学业后颁发的证书

entries.definition: careful not to hurt or annoy people
showing good judgment in dealing with people
entries.definitionCN: 在处理人事上显得明智的

entries.definition: polite in a formal and considerate way

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a paper folded in two and end with a hard answer that leaves no bruise.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一张对折的纸开始，最后落到一句不留淤青的硬话。

normal.en: Diploma, diplomat, diplomatic: paper, person, manner.
normal.cn: diploma 是纸，diplomat 是人，diplomatic 是方式。

normal.en: A folded letter travels far because it can be opened politely.
normal.cn: 对折的信能走很远，因为它可以被客气地打开。

normal.en: Diplomatic words are soft on the outside and firm inside.
normal.cn: diplomatic 的话，外面软，里面硬。

normal.en: You can be diplomatic without telling a lie.
normal.cn: 得体并不等于说谎。

normal.en: The same adjective serves treaties and dinner tables.
normal.cn: 同一个形容词，既服务条约，也服务饭桌。

abstract.en: Picture two flags on one long polished table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张光洁长桌上摆着两面小旗。

abstract.en: Picture a letter folded so that the seal sits outside.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信折得让火漆露在外面。

abstract.en: Picture a smile that closes a difficult sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象一个微笑，把一句难说的话收住了。

examples.en: The crisis was settled by diplomatic means.
examples.cn: 这场危机通过外交手段解决。

examples.en: It was diplomatic of you to say nothing.
examples.cn: 你什么也没说，这很得体。

examples.en: She has a diplomatic way of refusing.
examples.cn: 她拒绝人的方式很圆融。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 diplomatic 记成「地铺路马特」：地铺成路，马也走得稳，说话办事都讲分寸。

root: 来自拉丁语 diploma，指对折的公文，更早是希腊语 diploma（折成两半之物）。古代这种折纸用于携带推荐与通行文书，后来专指国家间的正式文件，再转指处理这些文件的官员与方式，于是有了「外交的」与「圆融得体的」两层意思。

sensesIntro.en: From an official paper folded in two, to the craft of keeping nations talking, to the small skill of not wounding a friend.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一张对折的公文，到让两国继续对话的手艺，再到不伤朋友的小本事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two flags facing each other across one polished table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张光洁长桌，两端各立一面小旗。

chain: A HARD THING IS SAID SOFTLY

branches.en: The first sense belongs to states and their papers.
branches.cn: 第一个义项属于国家与它们的文书。

branches.en: The second sense belongs to anyone at any table.
branches.cn: 第二个义项属于任何桌上的任何人。

branches.en: Both are about keeping a relationship alive through speech.
branches.cn: 两者都是靠说话让一段关系活下去。

branches.en: Tact is diplomacy shrunk to the size of a family.
branches.cn: 圆融，就是缩小到家庭尺寸的外交。

branches.en: The same courtesy works on treaties and on neighbours.
branches.cn: 同一份客气，对条约有用，对邻居也有用。

intro.en: Diplomatic gathers the diplo- family of papers, officials and manners.
intro.cn: diplomatic 聚起 diplo 一族词，围绕文书、官员与举止。

latinIntro.en: The base is Greek diploma, a thing folded in two, taken into Latin as an official document.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是希腊语 diploma（对折之物），进入拉丁语后指正式文书。

items.example: They chose a diplomatic path.
items.exampleCN: 他们选了一条外交途径。

items.example: The diplomat spoke three languages.
items.exampleCN: 这位外交官会说三种语言。

items.example: Quiet diplomacy ended the dispute.
items.exampleCN: 低调的外交结束了争端。

items.example: He diplomatically avoided the question.
items.exampleCN: 他委婉地避开了这个问题。

items.example: She framed her diploma.
items.exampleCN: 她把毕业证书装进框里。

items.meaning: not careful with other people's feelings
items.example: His undiplomatic remark ended the meal.
items.exampleCN: 他那句不得体的话结束了饭局。

items.meaning: the study of old official documents
items.example: Diplomatics helps date old charters.
items.exampleCN: 文书学有助于给旧契据断代。

items.meaning: a holder of a specialist certificate
items.example: The clinic lists every diplomate by name.
items.exampleCN: 诊所把每位持证专家的名字都列出来。

definition_zh: 直接的；直率的；指导；导演；指向
definition_en: going straight without anything in between, or to manage and guide something
core_image: 一支笔直的箭头穿过所有弯路，从一个点直指另一个点
scene: 他在纸上画了一条直线，把两个点连起来，中间不绕。She asked a direct question and waited for an answer.
sceneCN: 这里 direct 指「直接的」（第 1 个义项：不绕弯）；句意是她问了一个直接的问题，然后等着回答。

senses.title: Without a turn
senses.definition: going from one point to another with nothing in between
senses.definitionCN: 从一点到另一点，中间不夹别的东西
senses.example: There is a direct train to the airport.
senses.exampleCN: 有一趟直达机场的火车。
senses.why: The shortest line is also the one with no story to tell.
senses.whyCN: 最短的那条线，也是没有故事可讲的那条。

senses.title: Saying it plainly
senses.definition: saying what one means without softening it
senses.definitionCN: 把意思说出来，不做软处理
senses.example: He gave a direct answer, yes or no.
senses.exampleCN: 他给了直接的回答，行或不行。
senses.why: The words take the same straight path the arrow does.
senses.whyCN: 话也走那条直线，和箭头一样。

senses.title: To steer a group or a film
senses.definition: to tell people where to go or how to act
senses.definitionCN: 告诉人往哪儿走、该怎么演
senses.example: She directed the play for a small theatre.
senses.exampleCN: 她为一家小剧场导演了这出戏。
senses.why: Someone must hold the line so that others can follow it.
senses.whyCN: 总得有人按住那条线，别人才好跟着走。

intro.en: Direct comes from Latin dirigere, to set straight, from dis- and regere, to rule or guide.
intro.cn: direct 来自拉丁语 dirigere（弄直），由 dis- 与 regere（引导、统治）构成。

items.en: Regere meant to guide a line or to rule people.
items.cn: regere 指把线拉直，也指治理人。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set something in a straight line.
items.cn: dirigere 指把东西摆成直线。

items.en: The participle directus described a straight path.
items.cn: 分词 directus 形容笔直的路。

items.en: English direct meant straight, and soon also to guide.
items.cn: 英语 direct 先指笔直，很快也指引导。

items.en: Film gave the verb its sense of steering a production.
items.cn: 电影让这个动词多出「执导一部作品」的意思。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the rect- stem, while the meaning group covers straightness and guiding.
note.cn: 形近组共用 rect 词干，近义组则覆盖笔直与引导。

entries.definition: a person who manages or directs
an official instruction telling people what to do
entries.definitionCN: 指示人们如何做的正式指令

entries.definition: a list of names, addresses or files
entries.definitionCN: 姓名、地址或文件的列表

entries.definition: going forward without bending
to show someone the way
to lead or manage an activity

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with an arrow crossing a page and end with a director holding a whole play in line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一支穿过纸面的箭头开始，最后落到把整出戏按在一条线上的导演。

normal.en: Regere is to rule a line: direct is to keep it straight.
normal.cn: regere 是把线拉直：direct 就是让它别弯。

normal.en: A direct flight has no city in the middle.
normal.cn: 直达航班中间没有别的城市。

normal.en: A direct answer saves everyone an hour.
normal.cn: 一个直接的回答，替所有人省下一小时。

normal.en: To direct people is to point, not to push.
normal.cn: direct 人是指方向，不是推人。

normal.en: Indirect is the same line with one bend added.
normal.cn: indirect 就是同一条线多拐了一个弯。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow drawn with a ruler across a map.
abstract.cn: 想象用尺子在地图上画出一道箭头。

abstract.en: Picture a signpost with one arm pointing home.
abstract.cn: 想象一块路牌，只有一只手指向家。

abstract.en: Picture a stage where every actor faces the same point.
abstract.cn: 想象舞台上所有演员都朝向同一点。

examples.en: The direct cause of the fire was a loose wire.
examples.cn: 这场火灾的直接原因是一根松动的电线。

examples.en: He directs a small company in the north.
examples.cn: 他在北方经营一家小公司。

examples.en: Please direct your questions to the manager.
examples.cn: 请把问题交给经理。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 direct 记成「地雷刻特」：地上刻一条直线，绕过雷，直着走。

root: 来自拉丁语 dirigere，由 dis-（分开）与 regere（引导、弄直）构成，本义是把东西摆成直线。由「笔直」引申出「直接的」「直率的」，由「把线拉直」引申出「指引、管理」，近代又用于「导演」一部作品。

sensesIntro.en: From a line with no bend, to words with no padding, to a hand that keeps others on the line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条不弯的线，到一句不加铺垫的话，再到一只把别人按在线上手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow crossing a page without one bend.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支穿过纸面的箭头，一次也不弯。

chain: A WHOLE WORK FOLLOWS ONE WILL

branches.en: The first sense is the straight path itself.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是那条笔直的路。

branches.en: The second sense puts the straight path into speech.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这条直线放进话里。

branches.en: The third sense turns the line into command.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这条线变成指令。

branches.en: A straight road and a plain answer share one adjective.
branches.cn: 直路与直话共用一个形容词。

branches.en: Telling the truth and telling people where to go both need a firm line.
branches.cn: 说实话与指方向，都需要一条稳的线。

intro.en: Direct anchors the rect- family, all of it about straight lines and right guidance.
intro.cn: direct 撑起 rect 一族词，全都围绕直线与正确引导。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin regere, to guide straight, with the prefix dis- intensifying the setting.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 regere（拉直、引导），前缀 dis- 加强「摆正」的意味。

items.example: They took the most direct route.
items.exampleCN: 他们走了最直接的那条路。

items.meaning: the line in which something moves

definition_en: the line in which someone or something moves, points or develops
core_image: 一只指南针的针尖稳稳停住，四周刻着一圈细密的刻度
scene: 雾里看不清路，他低头看表盘上那根细针。The arrow points in the direction of the river.
sceneCN: 这里 direction 指「方向」（第 1 个义项：移动或指向的那条线）；句意是箭头指向河的方向。

senses.title: The line of movement
senses.definition: the line along which someone or something moves or points
senses.definitionCN: 人或物移动、指向所沿的那条线
senses.example: The bird flew in the direction of the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 那只鸟朝海的方向飞去。
senses.why: Every movement must choose one line and give up all the others.
senses.whyCN: 每一次移动都要挑一条线，同时放弃所有别的线。

senses.title: Instructions on how to do
senses.definition: words that tell someone how to reach a place or use a thing
senses.definitionCN: 告诉人怎么到某处或怎么用某物的那几句话
senses.example: Read the directions before you take the medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 吃药之前先看说明。
senses.why: A line on a map becomes a line of words.
senses.whyCN: 地图上的一条线，变成了一行字。

senses.title: The act of guiding
senses.definition: the control or leadership given to a piece of work
senses.definitionCN: 对一项工作给予的管理与带领
senses.example: The project grew under her direction.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目在她的指导下发展起来。
senses.why: The one who holds the line also decides where it will end.
senses.whyCN: 握住那条线的人，也决定它最后停在哪里。

intro.en: Direction comes from Latin directio, a setting straight, from dirigere, to guide.
intro.cn: direction 来自拉丁语 directio（摆正），词根是 dirigere（引导）。

items.en: Regere meant to keep a line straight or to rule.
items.cn: regere 指把线拉直，也指治理。

items.en: Dirigere meant to aim something along a line.
items.cn: dirigere 指让某物沿着一条线走。

items.en: Directio named the act of setting straight.
items.cn: directio 指摆正、对准这个动作。

items.en: English direction first meant the act of aiming.
items.cn: 英语 direction 最初指瞄准、对准的动作。

items.en: It widened to the line itself, to instructions and to leadership.
items.cn: 它扩展到那条线本身，也指说明与领导。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct- stem, while the meaning group names routes and bearings.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词干，近义组则分别指路线与方位。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a compass needle and end with a project led by one steady hand.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一根指南针开始，最后落到由一只稳手带起来的项目。

normal.cn: direction 是 direct 变成能用手去指的东西。

normal.en: Ask for directions means asking for words in place of a map.
normal.cn: 问路，是用一句话代替一张地图。

normal.en: A sense of direction lives in the body, not in the phone.
normal.cn: 方向感住在身体里，不在手机里。

normal.en: In all directions means the choice has not been made yet.
normal.cn: in all directions 是说还没做出选择。

normal.en: Under her direction means she holds the line for everyone.

abstract.cn: 想象拐角路面上画着一个箭头。

abstract.en: Picture a row of walkers all leaning one way.

examples.en: The package came with clear directions.

examples.en: The research moved in a new direction.

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 direction 记成「地雷克神」：地上的雷要绕开，得先看清哪边是方向。

root: 来自拉丁语 directio，由 dirigere（引导、弄直）而来，而 dirigere 又由 dis- 与 regere（拉直、统治）构成。本义是「摆正、对准」这个动作，后来指移动所沿的那条线，再引申为告诉人怎么走的说明，以及对工作的领导。

sensesIntro.en: From a needle choosing one line, to words that replace a map, to a hand that keeps a whole project on course.
sensesIntro.cn: 从指针选定一条线，到代替地图的几句话，再到把整个项目按在路上的那只手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a compass needle stopping on one line among many.
core.cn: 核心意象：指南针在许多条线里停住了一条。

branches.en: The first sense is the chosen line in space.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是空间里被选中的那条线。

branches.en: The second sense is the same line told in words.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把同一条线用话说出来。

branches.en: The third sense is the hand that keeps others on it.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是把别人按在这条线上的那只手。

branches.en: A map and its instructions describe one path.
branches.cn: 地图与说明描述的是同一条路。

branches.en: Good instructions are leadership written down.
branches.cn: 好的说明，就是写下来的领导。

intro.en: Direction sits at the centre of the rect- family of straight lines and guidance.
intro.cn: direction 位于 rect 一族的中心，这一族围绕直线与引导。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin regere, to guide straight, reached through dirigere.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 regere（拉直、引导），经 dirigere 传下来。

definition_en: in a straight or immediate way, with nothing in between
core_image: 一束光穿过敞开的窗，直直落在桌面，不碰墙也不拐弯
scene: 窗子正对着太阳，光一路照到桌中央。The road runs directly to the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 directly 指「径直地」（第 1 个义项：不绕路）；句意是这条路直通港口。

senses.title: By a straight path
senses.definition: along a line with no turn and nothing in the way
senses.definitionCN: 沿着一条不拐弯、也没有遮挡的线
senses.example: The road runs directly to the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 这条路直通港口。
senses.why: The shortest path is also the least eventful.
senses.whyCN: 最短的路线，也是最没有故事的一条。

senses.title: With no one in between
senses.definition: done by the person or thing itself, without another hand
senses.definitionCN: 由本人或本物完成，中间不经别人的手
senses.example: You can speak directly to the manager.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以直接和经理谈。
senses.why: A chain of hands slows every message and changes it.
senses.whyCN: 一串手递过去，消息既变慢也变形。

senses.title: At once, without delay
senses.definition: immediately after something happens
senses.definitionCN: 在事情发生后马上
senses.example: She left directly after the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 会议一结束她就走了。
senses.why: No turn in space becomes no gap in time.
senses.whyCN: 空间上不拐弯，就变成了时间上不留缝。

intro.en: Directly is direct plus the adverb ending -ly, built on Latin dirigere, to guide straight.
intro.cn: directly 是 direct 加副词词尾 -ly，词根是拉丁语 dirigere（拉直、引导）。

items.en: Regere meant to guide or to keep straight.
items.cn: regere 指引导，也指保持笔直。

items.en: Directus described something set in a straight line.
items.cn: directus 形容被摆成直线的东西。

items.en: English direct meant straight and plain.
items.cn: 英语 direct 指笔直与直白。

items.en: The ending -ly made it describe the manner of an action.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 让它转而描述动作的方式。

items.en: It added the time sense of immediately, and a conjunction use.
items.cn: 它又添上「立即」的时间义，并发展出连词用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct- stem, while the meaning group covers straightness, immediacy and personal action.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词干，近义组则覆盖径直、立即与亲自。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with light crossing an open window and end with a meeting that ends and empties the room.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从光穿过敞开的窗开始，最后落到一散会就空了的那间屋。

normal.en: Direct plus -ly: the adjective learns to describe how.
normal.cn: direct 加 -ly：形容词学会了说明「怎么做」。

normal.en: Directly above means not a little above.
normal.cn: directly above 是正上方，不是稍高一点。

normal.en: Speak directly and the message loses its middlemen.
normal.cn: 直接说，消息就没了中间人。

normal.en: In British use, directly can mean as soon as.
normal.cn: 在英式用法里，directly 还能表示「一……就」。

normal.en: A direct road and a direct answer both skip the scenery.
normal.cn: 直路与直话，都省掉了沿途的风景。

abstract.en: Picture a beam landing on a table without touching the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光落在桌上，没有碰到墙。

abstract.en: Picture two people talking with nobody seated between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人说话，中间没坐别人。

abstract.en: Picture a door closing behind the last guest at once.
abstract.cn: 想象最后一位客人一出门，门就关上了。

examples.en: The train goes directly to the city centre.
examples.cn: 这趟火车直达市中心。

examples.en: I heard the news directly from her.
examples.cn: 这消息是我直接从她那里听来的。

examples.en: He called directly after the letter arrived.
examples.cn: 信一到他就打了电话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 directly 记成「地雷克特利」：地上有雷，得看准一条直线，径直穿过去。

root: 由 direct 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，词根可追到拉丁语 dirigere（拉直、引导），由 dis- 与 regere 组成。它修饰动作，表示沿直线、不经中间人，或在时间上紧接着发生；英式英语里还发展出连词用法，表示「一……就」。

sensesIntro.en: From a path with no turn, to a word with no middleman, to a moment with no gap.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一条不拐弯的路，到一句不经中间人的话，再到一个不留缝的时刻。

branches.en: The first sense is the straight line in space.

branches.en: The second sense removes the middleman from an action.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把中间人从动作里拿掉。

branches.en: The third sense removes the gap in time.
branches.cn: 第三个义项拿掉了时间上的缝隙。

branches.en: A straight path and a direct word both refuse detours.
branches.cn: 直路与直话，都拒绝绕行。

branches.en: No middleman and no delay are the same impatience.
branches.cn: 不要中间人与不要等待，是同一种不耐烦。

intro.en: Directly is the adverb branch of the rect- family, with -ly marking manner.
intro.cn: directly 是 rect 一族的副词分支，-ly 标明方式。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin regere, to guide straight, reached through dirigere and directus.
